releases.notes:
# BingoHelper Version 0.9.0

### Changes
- Added option to only show guide instructions
  - Removes guide name and step # line from display
- Added "prerequisites" property
  - Basically a guide inside a single step
- Added "skyblockLevel" as an optional requirement for async steps
  - Useful for booster cookie
- Added movable huds
  - Available in /bhhud or /bh
  - R to reset
  - B to toggle background
  - Arrows to move
  - Scroll to scale
  - (Shift and Ctrl increase move/scale speed)

### Improvements
- Made a lot of things event based instead of constantly polling every tick
  - Scoreboard, tablist, async requirements, guide display etc
- Dwarven events are now considered complete if the user participated in the event
  - Only active events like goblin raid and raffle

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed sub areas not being detected
- Fixed mob types not being detected
- Navigation commands no longer send if skyhanni isn't installed

# BingoHelper Version 0.7.0

### Changes
- Updated to 1.21.11
- Added "async" step property
  - Registers step and goes to next immediately
- Added "navTo" step property
  - Uses SkyHanni's navigation system
- Added "bingoRanks" step property
  - Skips step if user's rank is not specified

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed "enchant" steps not always completing correctly
- Fixed shop item highlights sometimes flickering

releases.notes:
# BingoHelper Version 0.6.0

### Changes
- Added 1.21.10 support
- Added subcommands to /bhwaila which copy useful information
  - /bhwaila waypoint - copies waypoint data of targeted block/entity
  - /bhwaila outline - copies outlineEntity data of targeted entity
  - /bhwaila outlinewaypoint - copies full waypoint and outlineEntity data of targeted entity
- "Buy" steps now highlight the best slot to click
- Overhauled in-game update checker

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed "Has" steps not checking all player slots
  - Items in armor slots previously went undetected causing steps to not complete

releases.notes:
# BingoHelper Version 0.5.0

### Changes

- Added the ability to update the mod from the config menu
- Added "upgradeMinion" step type
  - Condenses many steps into one and is non-rank friendly
- Added the option to disable guide validation

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed skills and collections being tracked outside of bingo profiles
  - If you leveled a skill on another profile it would think you already had it on your bingo profile
- Skills and collections now reset when creating a bingo profile
